'''Niolle''' is one of the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' [[First Twelve]].

== Appearance ==
She is round-faced.

== Activities ==
She attends the meeting of the First Twelve with [[Rand al'Thor]]'s ambassador [[Logain Ablar]]. Near the end of the meeting [[Cemeille din Selaan Long Eyes]] interrupts with the news of the [[Amayar]] committing mass suicide.
